items.subject: Subject: one empty Korean scholar's jeongjagwan layered crown, an upright folded layered cap worn by a wandering scholar or Daoist. Its distinctive silhouette has two stacked angular scalloped/zigzag openwork tiers rising above a small round close-fitting head band, with no wide hat brim. Dark brown-black horsehair-like woven mesh with muted warm gray edge highlights; the layering and raised angular crown should be clear against a dark inventory slot. Show the whole empty hat from a slightly elevated front three-quarter angle. No head or stand. Avoid a European royal crown, spiky metal crown, two-wing official hat, broad-brim gat, straw hat, or conical wizard hat. Maintain sturdy continuous tiers rather than a fragile spray of narrow spikes. The game footprint is 2 by 2 cells.

items.subject: Subject: one empty pointed Korean iron helmet, cheomju, for a dark-fantasy wandering swordsman. Aged cool charcoal steel, moderate gray metal edge highlights, dark brown leather beneath; one tiny aged-bronze fastener is enough. Whole helmet from front three-quarter view, modest opening visible. The tall pointed iron shape must be immediately different from a round brown leather cap. No horns, animal faces, huge spikes, jewel, European nasal guard, crusader face plate, samurai crest, full face mask, loose separate parts, head or stand. The game footprint is 2 by 2 cells.

items.subject: Subject: one handheld Korean geomantic compass, yundo / paechol, a thick compact circular disk viewed slightly from above at a three-quarter angle so its full round face and narrow wooden side are visible. Weathered warm dark wood rim enclosing an aged muted-brass face, four simple broad concentric bands, one clearly visible small central compass needle. The concentric directional system should read at small size, using sparse dark abstract tick marks instead of legible writing or many fine letters. Modest red-brown accent on one needle tip. A useful old scholar's navigation tool, not a magical glowing orb. No hanging chain, handles, lid, separate parts, glass glare, European nautical compass box, star pentagram, legible words or clock numerals. The game footprint is 2 by 2 cells.

items.subject: Subject: one wooden talisman printing block, bujeok mokpan, a solid compact rectangular slab of dark warm worn wood with one broad carved printing face fully visible in a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. The face has a single recessed/relief abstract talisman design with a few bold vertical and hooked strokes and a little muted cinnabar red ink residue inside the cuts; avoid readable calligraphy. Broad grain, chipped corners, clear thick wooden side edge. Emphasize that this is a carved wooden printing plate, not a paper talisman, closed box, folding book, brush case or hand stamp. No handle, no paper sheet, no stamp pressed beside it, no extra object. The slab is slightly taller than wide but comfortably fits a 2 by 2 cell inventory footprint.

items.subject: Subject: one large round dark ochre herbal medicine pill, cheongsimhwan, sitting within its single partially opened cream hanji-paper wrapper. Soft muted golden-brown pill, aged cream paper, no vial or bowl. Slightly elevated front view, strong circular pill silhouette and simple bright paper collar. It must remain clearly legible as a round medicinal pill rather than a potion bottle, coin, biscuit or sack at just 40 pixels. No printed text, decorative logo, ribbon, extra pills, separate wrapper scraps, fruit or spoon. The game footprint is 1 by 1 cell.

Strong paper silhouette filling a 1 by 1 cell slot without becoming a long narrow scroll. No fire motif, glowing lightning, floating sparks, readable letters, border frame, tied string, bundle, second sheet or wax seal.
